name: USAA Eagle Navigator™ Visa Signature® Credit Card

benefits.name: Annual 10,000 Bonus Points
benefits.description: 10,000 bonus points (equal to $100 in travel) each year after booking an eligible hotel or car through the USAA Rewards Center.
benefits.terms: Requires completing an eligible hotel or rental car booking through the USAA Rewards Center. Whether the year resets on the calendar or the account anniversary is not stated in available sources; confirm against USAA's terms before relying on the reset date.

benefits.name: TSA PreCheck / Global Entry Credit
benefits.description: Statement credit of up to $120 for a TSA PreCheck or Global Entry application fee, every four years.

benefits.name: Auto Rental Coverage
benefits.description: Secondary collision damage waiver coverage for eligible rental cars.
benefits.terms: Secondary coverage. Decline the rental company's collision coverage and pay with the card.

benefits.name: Trip Cancellation & Interruption Coverage
benefits.description: Reimbursement up to $1,500 per covered person for prepaid, non-refundable travel expenses.

benefits.name: Baggage Delay Reimbursement
benefits.description: Up to $100 a day for up to 3 days for essential purchases when checked baggage is delayed.

benefits.name: Travel Accident Insurance
benefits.description: Accidental death and dismemberment coverage when common-carrier fare is charged to the card.

benefits.name: Cell Phone Protection
benefits.description: Up to $500 of coverage against damage or theft when the monthly cell phone bill is paid with the card.

benefits.name: Purchase Security
benefits.description: Covers new purchases against damage or theft, up to $1,000 per claim.

benefits.name: Extended Warranty Protection
benefits.description: Extended warranty protection on eligible U.S. manufacturers' warranties.

earningRates.terms: Travel and transit, including air, hotel, car and vacation rentals, rideshare, and tolls.
